summary: Alibaba Group Holding Ltd filed a Form 6-K with Exhibit 99.1 announcing a grant of 61,716,712 share awards (0.32% of outstanding shares) to employees under the 2024 Plan, with a nil purchase price and HK$120.90 closing price. Awards vest over mixed schedules up to 4 years, some with performance targets. This is a routine equity grant, not a special situation.
